name: propertypilot-ai
description: PropertyPilot AI - governed property intelligence and deal-analysis platform by Faith Wright

scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && node index.js" "cd client && npx vite --host"
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.check: npm run build && node -e "const { calculateDeal } = require('./server/scoring'); const r = calculateDeal({purchasePrice:200000,gdv:250000,monthlyRent:1400}); if (!Number.isFinite(r.roi)) process.exit(1); console.log(r);"
